info.title: Nudge API
info.description: HTTP API for Nudge, an open-source, self-hostable task manager.

get.description: Report whether the API and its database are working.
Return the signed-in user, or no user, and set the CSRF cookie the frontend needs.

post.description: Start a session for the user with these credentials.
Change the signed-in user's password, keeping this session and ending all others.

patch.description: Change the signed-in user's name and return the updated user.

put.description: Change the signed-in user's time zone and return the updated user.

get.description: Return the user's latest notifications and their unread count.

delete.description: Remove one notification from the notification center.

post.description: Notify the user, to check that notifications reach their devices.

get.description: Return the key browsers need to subscribe, if the server has push set up.

post.description: Push the user's notifications to this browser.

delete.description: Stop pushing the user's notifications to this browser.

get.description: Return the user's Inbox with its open Task count.

Return a Project's open Tasks in manual order, or, with `closed`, a page of Closed ones.

Closed Tasks come most recently completed first, in pages; open Tasks come all at once.

post.description: Add a Task first in its Project, or in the Inbox when no Project is given.

get.description: Return a Task with everything the detail drawer shows.

patch.description: Change a Task's fields, returning it and every Task whose Status changed.

get.description: Return a page of a Task's history, newest first, with the number of events in all.

post.summary: Attach a file to a Task
post.description: Store one file against a Task, up to the configured size.

get.description: Return a Task's Attachments, oldest first.
Send an Attachment's bytes, inline for images and PDFs and as a download otherwise.

delete.description: Delete an Attachment and its file for good.
